    return f"""Classify whether this customer support dialog contains a COMPLAINT about a FLIGHT BOOKING ISSUE.

A "flight booking issue" includes problems such as:
- Unable to book/purchase a flight
- Booking system errors or website/app issues when trying to book
- Double bookings or incorrect bookings
- Booking not showing up or confirmation issues
- Problems modifying/changing an existing flight booking
- Booking cancellation problems
- Incorrect charges during booking
- Seat selection issues during booking
- Issues with booking references/confirmation numbers

This does NOT include:
- General flight delays or cancellations (operational issues)
- Baggage issues
- In-flight service complaints
- Loyalty program issues (unless directly related to booking)
- Meal selection issues
- Check-in issues (unless related to booking not found)
- Refund requests (unless about a booking error)

Dialog:
{truncated}

Answer ONLY "YES" if this is a complaint about a flight booking issue, or "NO" if it is not.
Answer:"""
